notes.title: Changelog 0.16b - to VR or not to VR
notes.content: 👉 The Game now starts properly into VR again. My bad x)

notes.title: Changelog 0.16 - Shop fixes
notes.content:
💪 Purchasing one of the Season-passes now grants the correct season! Seems obvious now 🤷
  👉 All previously purchased Items will be granted shortly! Sorry!

notes.title: Changelog 0.14b - bringing order to reverse order
notes.content:
💪 While the last shall be first, this is no longer true for the highscore list in the Shooting Challenges (order was reversed)
✊ Fixed slight offset when shooting.

notes.title: Changelog 0.14 - Shooting challenge
notes.content:
💪 We added new challenges around the island. Seek them out and get your training in! Don't skip arm day!
✊👉💪👌 One challenge for each weapon type

notes.title: Changelog 0.13b - Hotter winter fixes
notes.content:
💪 When trying to join the CTF mode multiple times quickly the game broke.
👉 We could not handle your enthusiasm... but now we can!

notes.title: Changelog 0.13 - Hot winter fixes
notes.content:
✊ The Flag can no longer be taken into the spawn zone!
💪 Arms should no longer do the jerky dance... => Better arm interpolation.

notes.title: Changelog 0.11 -flag as fixes!
notes.content:
💪 Added spawn protection so you can't be spawn-camped, that was legs...
💪 We now auto balance the teams if they are too off kilter. 
💪 A draw is now an option!

notes.title: Changelog 0.8 -matchmaking has 8 arms
notes.content:
💪 Show season progress in the main menu.
💪 Fixed matchmaking to only get 4 players per game.
💪 New players now really have arms. For sure this time.
💪 Fixed mimics scoring before the game even started.
💪 Hunters now score 2 points per catch. One for each arm.

notes.title: Changelog 0.7 -Voice has arms
notes.content:
💪Added In-Game voice over to tell you all that you can high-five other Mimics!
💪More Wall-Arms to high-five when playing 1v1.
💪New players now have arms. Because everything should have arms.

notes.title: Changelog 0.6 -hotfix
notes.content: 👉 New players now have arms. Because everything should have arms.

notes.title: Changelog 0.6 -Sweet summer arms
notes.content:
To celebrate the end of summer, we released a new update

[url=https://everything-has-arms.com/images/events/2022-09-summer.jpg][img]https://everything-has-arms.com/images/events/2022-09-summer.jpg[/img][/url]

💪 Added new unlockable Arms and Heads! Play games to unlock them.
💪 Added additional Arm and Head to Supporter bundle.
💪 Fixed highfive hands in Prophunt not respawning correctly.
💪 Ongoing improvements to movement stability. 

PSA: Always use sunscreen on your arms!

notes.title: Changelog 0.5 -hotfix
notes.content: 🙏 Fixed a bug where joining a lobby at peak times did not work for some players.

notes.title: Changelog 0.4 -server skipped leg day
notes.content:
💪 Improved server stability and connectivity (ongoing -on arms)
💪 Improved Lobby instantiation to better deal with server spikes
👉 Fixed bullets not spawning sometimes -pew pew
👉 Fixed incorrect skin tones on arms

We pulled an arm for this one. Please enjoy!

notes.title: 💪Changelog 0.3
notes.content:
Changelog 0.3 -has options

💪 Added an option to disable the Vignette when going weeeee (fast) 
💪 Added an option to disable snap turning. For the folks with broken controllers.
👍 Fixed an issue with spawning in the incorrect location when changing scenes.
👍 Fixed the pling bling not despawning correctly. Too much bling.

Now go hunt those props!

notes.title: 💪 Hotfix 0.2 👍
notes.content:
How could we launch a game without a day-1 patch, so here it is:

Changelog! 0.2 -has arms

💪 fixed: Some players got their head stuck inside a cat. Not nice.
👍 added: You can now select the server region you want to join! Armazing!

Thank you for the lending us a hand in finding theses issues!
